claim: In the stock exe code: sail values 1 stationary, 2 battle sail, 4 half sail, 8 full sail (script table 0x1451968; "" = 0). set_sail builds the generic one-int ctor 0x5992c0 but its command type [0x14a5fac] is pushed inline only (no out-of-line push function), so the route orders sails through the move ctor sail argument; readback = SHIP+0x1b88 mapped as the engine getter 0x6d8be0 does
notes: static (stock exe sha1 9aebcd21..., disassembly with re/j60re.py); the runtime meaning is open in napoleon.battle.ship_orders (owner: J60 PC slot)
